dst: Dr. Chavarría, specialist in plastic and reconstructive surgery. Since 2016 he has been a pioneer in high-definition liposculpture techniques

He worked as an attending physician in the Breast Functional Unit of the Catalan Institute of Oncology (ICO), where he gained in-depth experience of all pathologies associated with the female breast and performed microsurgical reconstructions.
